items.prompt: At a node, next-period claim values are 10 in the down state and 30 in the up state. The risk-neutral up weight is 0.4 and the one-period discount factor is 0.95. Calculate the current node value.

At a bond-tree node, next-period ex-coupon values are 90 and 110, both states also pay a coupon of 5, the risk-neutral up weight is 0.25, and the node discount factor is 0.96. Calculate the current node value.
